models.agentic_summary: Tool calls, JSON output, Responses and Anthropic formats are documented; Hermes core carries the DeepSeek thinking-mode reasoning-content echo handling and DEEPSEEK_V4 effort mapping (xhigh clamps to max). Live use is confirmed by the current main/delegation route.
models.coding_summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash cost-efficient API model; already the configured main and delegation model on this install, so it is the working non-subscription Light lane.

pricing.notes: Peak rates; off-peak is half ($0.15 / $0.003 / $0.60) outside weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC. Concurrency limit 2500.

recommended_use: declared Light fallback for scoped implementation and mechanical work when the subscription lane is exhausted
tests, lint, typecheck and build loops, straightforward repair, log collection

models.agentic_summary: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API with function calling, structured output and streaming; deep thinking is enabled by default and switched via thinking.type with no effort ladder. Hermes ships a native 'xiaomi' provider profile and explicit MiMo reasoning-echo handling in core, so the known thinking plus tool-call replay hazard is covered by the client; the key is configured in every profile and a live routed child run on 2026-09-22 confirmed the route (exit 0, unchanged config, verified session metadata on a mechanical task) after an API-level check showed function calling and reasoning-echo replay both returning 200.
models.coding_summary: Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 flagship (released 2026-09-22): open-weights trillion-parameter MoE that tops the open-weights tier on the Artificial Analysis index (46) with vendor-reported agentic coding above the previous MiMo generation; positioned by Xiaomi below frontier closed models, at roughly 1/20 of their API price.

pricing.notes: Overseas pay-as-you-go rates (domestic CNY list 3.00 / 0.025 / 6.00); Batch API 50% ($0.2175 / $0.435); UltraSpeed from the same checkpoint about 10x ($4.35 / $8.70); web search is billed per call and not included.

recommended_use: declared Heavy fallback for complex work when the subscription lane is exhausted
long-horizon agentic coding and independent review at a fraction of frontier API cost

set_selection_rule: Select the candidate set whose family matches the lane currently in use, then keep fallback_routes mirroring that set. Switching sets is a compare-and-swap cache edit, never a per-call config mutation.
